question: Show the names of singers that have more than one song.
gold_query: SELECT T1.Name FROM singer AS T1 JOIN song AS T2 ON T1.Singer_ID  =  T2.Singer_ID GROUP BY T1.Name HAVING COUNT(*)  >  1
